headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI gains at the top firms.
summary: TCS posted ₹73,188 cr revenue with a 24% operating margin and AI revenue above 10% of total. HCLTech and LTM also showed double‑digit top‑line growth, highlighting AI as a key driver. Mid‑tier players such as Infosys and Wipro reported healthy revenue growth but mixed profit trends. Several smaller firms have not yet released results, limiting full sector visibility.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑related revenue and deal wins are highlighted by TCS, HCLTech and LTM, supporting higher margins and profit growth.

themes.title: Margin pressure at mid‑tier
themes.detail: Wipro's operating margin slipped to 16.5% and profit fell YoY, indicating cost pressures despite revenue growth.
